purpose: Evaluate prospective binary SERPIENTE predictions against point-in-time eligible observed outcomes without temporal leakage, while preserving ascertainment, baseline, regime and intervention metadata.

temporal_rules.outcome_eligibility: outcome_time >= origin_time + horizon and outcome_time >= available_at
temporal_rules.information_set_rule: The evaluation system may only treat a forecast as eligible when its persisted availability timestamp is at or before the evaluation reference time. Point-in-time fingerprint provenance remains a producer responsibility and is not inferred from the prediction timestamp alone.

population.domain: producer-declared reference class and OOD state
population.evaluation_window: must be registered before outcome inspection with immutable start/end and protocol version
population.subgroup_analysis: not established until a scientifically justified subgroup schema and adequate sample size exist

outcome_ascertainment.scoring_eligibility: missing, partial, censored or selected outcomes are excluded from binary scoring and retained as explicit non-eligible states
outcome_ascertainment.revision_rule: revision identity must be preserved; a revised outcome must not silently overwrite a previously evaluated observation
outcome_ascertainment.intervention_rule: intervention_exposure_id is recorded when applicable; intervention-exposed outcomes are not interpreted as untreated counterfactual outcomes

metrics.discrimination: not estimated by the current aggregate endpoint; requires outcome population and paired negative/positive labels across an evaluation window
metrics.baseline_comparison: required before claiming comparative predictive utility; comparator must be registered at forecast origin and evaluated on the same eligible population
metrics.inference: descriptive only until a dependence-aware inferential procedure is predeclared and validated

baseline.origin_time_validity: baseline inputs must be restricted to the same information set available at forecast origin
baseline.paired_comparison: model and baseline must be evaluated on the same eligible outcome records

dependence.repeated_forecasts: allowed as observations but not assumed independent
dependence.current_inference: descriptive aggregate only; no confidence interval or hypothesis test is emitted
dependence.required_future_extension: clustered or time-aware uncertainty accounting if inferential claims are introduced

regime_and_feedback.regime_label_required: prospective evaluation records should retain declared OOD/distribution-shift and intervention state where available
regime_and_feedback.intervention_feedback: forecast -> decision -> action -> outcome is a distinct feedback path; predictive validity and intervention effectiveness are separate estimands
regime_and_feedback.distribution_shift: monitor or stratify by predeclared regime labels; do not reinterpret retrospective regime changes as prospective validation

missing_outcomes.policy: exclude outcomes that are not yet eligible; do not impute them as observed
missing_outcomes.selection_warning: ascertainment selection remains an explicit limitation even when selected records are excluded from scoring

prospective_validity.reason: Software fixtures and historical replay do not establish real-world prospective predictive validity.
prospective_validity.minimum_evidence: A predeclared evaluation window with prospectively generated forecasts, prospectively ascertained outcomes, complete point-in-time eligibility records, predefined target/horizon population, registered baseline, and a locked evaluation procedure.

causal_validity.reason: Prediction error metrics do not identify intervention effects or causal benefit.
